Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Coordinator (Benelux & Nordics) position. With 1-3 years of marketing coordination experience, including hands-on campaign support, event planning, and content development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your international veterinary technology business.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, while tracking performance with analytics tools. I have also planned and delivered customer-facing events, such as webinars and workshops, and coordinated with sales teams to ensure strong lead follow-up. My project mirook.com involved developing a full marketing plan, managing social media, and implementing structured data to improve search visibility.

Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I am fluent in English and Dutch (B1, actively improving), and I am willing to travel regularly across Benelux and occasionally to Sweden and the UK. I am eager to bring my organizational skills, attention to detail, and proactive mindset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can support your regional marketing goals.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Coordinator (Benelux & Nordics) position at your company. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in campaign coordination, event planning, and content development, I am eager to contribute to your mission of improving animal care through innovative technology.

In my current role at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and delivering marketing campaigns. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, while tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. I have also coordinated webinars and workshops, working closely with sales teams to ensure effective lead capture and follow-up. This experience has honed my ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

My project mirook.com further demonstrates my initiative and versatility. I developed a comprehensive marketing plan, designed and built the website, and implemented structured data to improve search visibility. I also managed social media content and engaged with the local chess community, which gave me insight into building customer relationships and representing a brand professionally.

Based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, I am fluent in English and Dutch (B1, actively improving), and I am comfortable with regular travel across Benelux and occasional trips to Sweden and the UK. My technical background, combined with my marketing skills, allows me to quickly adapt to new tools and platforms, such as HubSpot, which I am eager to learn.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it offers the opportunity to work in an international, multi-market environment within the veterinary sector. I am passionate about using my skills to support regional teams and drive meaningful results. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my experience aligns with your needs.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
